body.heading: Start slow
paragraphs: Try this one very slowly: Red lorry, yellow lorry. Say each word clearly, like you are teaching a baby robot.
Now try: She sells seashells. Slow first. Speed comes later.

body.heading: Speed up and giggle
paragraphs: Say it a little faster each time. Soon the words will tangle, and that is the funniest part.
When everyone is laughing, slow right down and try to land it perfectly one last time.

takeaway: Tongue twisters are tiny games your mouth plays with tricky sounds.
materials: A glass of water for sip breaks
safetyNotes: Stop for a drink of water whenever you need one.
screenFreeExtension: Invent your own tongue twister using the name of your pet or your favourite food.
